title: Point cloud shapeshifter
technique: A cloud of about 124,000 points, sampled from 3D models and lettering, streams from one shape into the next.
music: Each new section of the song sends the cloud flying into its next shape, and every beat sweeps a bright band up through it. Kicks make the surface jump and throw light outward, bass swells the whole body, and vocals make scattered points shimmer.
as_processor: Rebuilds the picture out of about 124,000 points: a relief sheet whose points take the picture's colours and stand forward where it is bright, which then streams off into 3D models and back, or is printed as a two-ink halftone, traced as a contour map of its brightness, raked as a one-ink landscape, or shown through a wall of discs.

input_takes.0: the picture as a sheet of points in relief, morphing into models that wear it as a projection
input_takes.2: every disc takes the picture's colour at its place on screen
input_takes.3: picture laid flat with brightness as height, drawn as contour lines
input_takes.5: two-ink halftone of the picture in 12 pixel cells
input_takes.7: picture as a raked one-ink relief sheet

takes.name: Sculpture
takes.description: A single object or phrase in its real colours stands on a reflecting floor in front of a sun made of print dots, seen by a slowly swinging camera.
words: POINT CLOUD
123,904 POINTS
ONE CLOUD / MANY SHAPES
POINT CLOUD MORPH / 123,904 POINTS SAMPLED FROM THE SURFACE / OF A 3D MODEL, EACH IN ITS TEXTURE COLOUR.
EVERY POINT HAS A PLACE ON TWO SHAPES. / WHEN THE SONG CHANGES SECTION / IT FLIES FROM ONE TO THE OTHER.
ONCE A BEAT A BRIGHT BAND CLIMBS THE CLOUD. / KICKS PUSH THE SURFACE OUTWARD. / VOCALS MAKE POINTS SHIMMER.

takes.name: Catalogue
takes.description: Fifteen small clouds sit in a five by three grid on flat paper, a different model in each cell, while the beat steps a highlight from cell to cell.
words: ONE CLOUD DEALT INTO 15 CELLS: POINT i GOES TO CELL i MOD 15.
15 SMALL CLOUDS OF ABOUT 8,260 POINTS EACH. NINE MODELS.
THE BEAT STEPS A HIGHLIGHT FROM CELL TO CELL.

takes.name: Inside
takes.description: The camera stands inside a model enlarged five times and looks out through its skin, so the picture becomes a wall of coloured discs rather than an object.
words: INSIDE THE CLOUD / THE CAMERA STANDS WITHIN A MODEL ENLARGED / FIVE TIMES AND LOOKS OUT THROUGH ITS SKIN.
INSIDE THE CLOUD / EVERY DISC IS ONE SURFACE POINT OF A 3D MODEL, / SEEN FROM THE WRONG SIDE.
INSIDE THE CLOUD / KICKS THROW THE PICTURE OUTWARD / AS RAYS OF VIDEO FEEDBACK.

takes.name: Plan
takes.description: The object is seen from straight above and drawn only as contour lines on a drawing grid, with a bright contour climbing it on each beat.
words: PLAN VIEW: THE CLOUD SEEN FROM STRAIGHT ABOVE. / ONLY POINTS NEAR A HEIGHT LEVEL ARE INKED, / SO THE MODEL DRAWS ITS OWN CONTOUR MAP.
CONTOUR LINES FROM POINTS / 15 HEIGHT LEVELS PER UNIT, CLIMBING SLOWLY. / A BRIGHT CONTOUR RISES ON EVERY BEAT.
NO MESH, NO LINES: JUST 123,904 POINTS. / THE ONES NEAR A HEIGHT LEVEL ARE DRAWN, / THE REST LEFT DARK.

takes.name: Streak
takes.description: Only a small fraction of the points are kept while the model spins fast in the dark, so each point drags its orbit out into a long line like a long exposure.
words: LONG EXPOSURE / ONLY 1 POINT IN 40 IS DRAWN. THE MODEL SPINS / AND THE FRAME FADES SLOWLY, SO POINTS DRAW LINES.
LONG EXPOSURE / EACH FRAME KEEPS ABOUT 99% OF THE LAST ONE. / A SPINNING POINT LEAVES ITS ORBIT BEHIND.
LONG EXPOSURE / ABOUT 3,100 POINTS OF 123,904, TURNING FAST. / THE TRAILS ARE VIDEO FEEDBACK.

takes.name: Raster
takes.description: The object is redrawn as a print screen of big flat discs in two inks on coloured paper, cropped close and off-centre with a line of type.
words: A HALFTONE / MADE OF POINTS.
DARKER SURFACE, / BIGGER DOT.
THE NEAREST POINT / WINS EACH CELL.

takes.name: Duel
takes.description: Two objects in two different inks stand side by side, seen from near the floor, with a strand of points continually pulled out of one and into the other.
words: TWO SHAPES, ONE CLOUD: HALF THE POINTS EACH. / A STRAND OF POINTS CROSSES FROM ONE TO THE OTHER. / KICKS TEAR MORE OF THEM LOOSE.
ONE INK PER SHAPE. A POINT IN THE STRAND / CHANGES INK AS IT CROSSES, IN FOUR BEATS.
6% OF THE POINTS ARE ALWAYS IN TRANSIT. / A HARD KICK PULLS A QUARTER OF THEM / OUT OF THEIR SHAPE.

takes.name: Phrase
takes.description: A short phrase is treated as a landscape in one pale ink on coloured stock, the camera raking along the letters from one end as the far end fades into the paper.
words: MADE OF / POINTS
POINT CLOUD
ONE CLOUD / MANY SHAPES
LETTERS SAMPLED INTO 123,904 POINTS, IN ONE INK. / DISTANCE FADES THEM INTO THE PAPER.
